basic_info.description: Perched atop a stately Edwardian elevator building in iconic Pacific Heights, this sophisticated south-facing corner condo captures the essence of classic San Francisco living. Bathed in natural light and framed by city views, this penthouse-level residence blends timeless architectural detail with over $100K in permitted updates. Offering two spacious bedrooms plus a flexible third space ideal as an office or nursery, and two beautifully remodeled baths, the layout provides excellent separation between sleeping quarters. The grand formal living and dining rooms evoke pre-war elegance with 10-ft box beam ceilings, intricate crown molding, and a decorative fireplace. The updated chef's kitchen features granite counters, ample cabinetry, high-end appliances, and a built-in pantry. Marble-tiled bathrooms, in-unit laundry, double-pane Marvin windows, hardwood floors, and a large private storage room complete this exceptional offering. Leased parking available nearby.
